_readme: Copy brands/_template to brands/<id>, then edit. See SEED.md. Folders starting with _ are never built.
name: Example Brand
description: One sentence for search results and link previews.

story: A short paragraph about the brand, in its own words.

shipping.note: US shipping only at launch. Rate set per drop.

policies.entity: [CONFIRM: legal name of the selling entity]
policies.exchange_shipping: [CONFIRM: who pays shipping on size exchanges]
policies.order_retention: [CONFIRM: how long order records are kept (suggest 7 years for tax records)]
policies.preorder_cancel: [CONFIRM: whether a pre-order can be cancelled for a full refund before its window closes]
policies.returns: Size exchanges within 14 days of delivery. Items must be unworn with tags.
policies._note: Policy pages (privacy, terms, returns, shipping, policies hub) render from core/policies.mjs. Every [CONFIRM] value and every *_status placeholder blocks a live build.

_orders: Order emails (core/email.mjs): the shop notification goes to orders_inbox; the customer confirmation comes from orders_from as from_name. PLACEHOLDER inboxes: confirm they exist (and verify the domain in Resend) before live checkout.
